notes.title: Game update - added achievement system and sandbox mode!
notes.notes:
Update content of version 20250513:
[list]
[*] Added sandbox mode
[*] Added 15 new Steam achievements
[*] Added right-click convenient tool recycling function
[*] Updated Italian localization
[*] Updated the cat-touching tool to change position with the store
[*] Fixed some UI display issues
[*] Fixed some store cat misalignment issues
[*] Added a button to temporarily hide the cat-touching tool
[/list]

Special thanks to James Stangle for his contribution to the Italian localization, great job!

notes.title: Kitten Food Alley Demo is Live !
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45350373/ba68ef48ccd1933013d927e1d319b2be158d0102.png[/img]
The casual simulation business cat petting game Kitten Food Alley developed by NOTISNOT STUDIO is now open for Demo version. welcome to try it for free!

In this Demo, two levels, Cat Village and Friendship Town, will be opened. The play time is between 30 minutes and 1 hour.

There will also be a feedback form in the game. Everyone is welcome to leave valuable suggestions after playing.

Have fun~!
